summary: Reproduced FR-VAE (Frequency-guided Residual-quantized VAE) with Frequency-guided Decomposer, Composer, and Residual-quantization. Implemented Autoregressive Transformer with multi-head attention and causal masking for next-frequency prediction. Created `frequency_utils.py` for dynamic frequency mask generation based on paper's formula. Outlined generation process in the transformer. Assumptions and missing details documented in `README.md`.
